author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: gamma_max=0.72 (k=45)
abstract: Micro-reduction of adaptive residualization strength under whitened ComBat PCA64 (tau=0.95), k=45 cosine balanced kNN. Hypothesis: small ASW_label/ARI/NMI gains with mixing unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc import run_pipeline
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline(adata,
                        n_pcs_emb=64, alpha=0.95,
                        n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.72, lam=0.9, l2=1e-3,
                        k_total=45, metric='cosine')
